title: Geo-IP hard-redirect → suggestion banner + cookie, keep all locales crawlable
gate: geo-IP hard-redirect → replaces with a suggestion banner + cookie, keeps all locales crawlable, explains detect-vs-routing.
expected: Hard-redirecting by geo-IP/Accept-Language means Googlebot (US) only ever sees US content and users can't reach a locale via a shared link — it tanks international rankings and traps users. Detection (picking a locale for an undecided user) is not routing (which URL serves which locale). Detect to SUGGEST via a banner/cookie, never hard-redirect — especially not the crawler. Keep every locale reachable by URL.
mustRefuse: force the user to their geo locale
